what: A small bird flies in from the bottom right (200,120px) after .25s over .35s (easeInCubic) and lands on a branch — the moment it lands, bird and branch tip to -8° (80ms) then settle with a 1s spring wobble, and the note the bird carried (notification) lights up. After that, every 5 seconds it shivers its body twice at -2° and 1 second later wags its tail four times

options.delay: Seconds from sticking to flying off, default .25
options.every: Interval (sec) for trembling and tail wagging, default 5
options.[data-fx-part=bird]: Bird (the one flying in) — must be present
options.[data-fx-part=tail]: (If any) Tail inside the bird — wags
options.[data-fx-part=branch]: (If present) Branch — bends along as it settles
options.[data-fx-part=note]: (if present) note a bird carries in — turns on when it lands

use:
Branch
Notice, one line

from.where: index.html .sk-top__perch (a bluebird that perches on the branch at the left edge of the Hero photo, with a notice note — original init.js loadingBirdIn: translate(200,120)→0 350ms delay 250 easeInCubic, rotateZ −8 80ms → 0 1000ms spring, branch same, then loadingBird every 5000ms: rotateZ −2 60ms loop 2, and 1000ms later tail scale 1.05·rotateZ −3·translateY −2 140ms easeOutCubic loop 4). After the loader clears (.4s later when arriving via a page transition), data-fx is attached and it fires

note: It starts flying the moment it attaches — if it must fly after the loader, the user attaches data-fx then. Sites that hide the bird on phones should not attach it.
